integrity: Exact analytical argument with an independently runnable numerical diagnostic; finite checks are not infinite proof, and historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Centered-bin marginalized wrapped Cauchy parent with a lattice-registered location; no classification for off-center marginalized origins. Population disjointness against all conditionalized angular locations, but the specific plug-in contrast is calibrated only for origin-registered conditionalized models. Uniform concentration boundary belongs to both families; no uniform near-null power assertion.
title: A sharp four-sector identifiability threshold for two discrete wrapped Cauchy constructions
